people.name: Faezeh Salehi
people.bio: Faezeh joined the Ph.D. program in January 2022. She uses eye-tracking, EEG, and data analysis to study how visual and spatial conditions affect perception and task performance in extreme environments. Her work contributes to NASA- and NSF-funded projects on astronaut training and immersive simulation.
people.focus: Spatial cognition · VR/AR · Eye-tracking · EEG · NASA Astronaut Training

people.name: Maryam Abbasi Kamazani
people.bio: Maryam joined in January 2022 with a background in Mechanical Engineering and multi-objective optimization of hybrid geothermal-PV systems. Her current research focuses on LCA, advanced optimization, and predictive methods for sustainable, low-carbon building design. Winner of the Best Paper Award at the International Conference on Net Zero Carbon Built Environment.
people.focus: LCA · Multi-objective optimization · ECW nexus · Climate-aware modeling · NSF

people.name: Sejal Sanjay Shanbhag
people.bio: Sejal has a background in architecture and earned her MTech in Building Energy Performance from CEPT University, where she worked on CFD-based airflow studies. Her current work examines how design choices affect energy use, carbon impacts, and indoor comfort under future climate conditions.
people.focus: LCA · Optimization · Low-carbon building design · Future climate scenarios

people.name: Yasaman Norouzi
people.bio: Yasaman joined in Fall 2022. As part of a DOE-funded project, she conducted life cycle assessments of buildings with 3D-printed hempcrete walls and developed optimization models to reduce energy use and carbon impacts. Her work combines environmental analysis, computational modeling, and predictive methods for building envelope performance.
people.focus: LCA · Hempcrete · 3D printing · Envelope optimization · DOE ARPA-E

people.name: Mana Nemati Aghdam
people.bio: Mana's research focuses on connecting carbon reduction and climate resilience in building design. She studies material performance, life cycle assessment, and hazard-related impacts on buildings, with a focus on vulnerable communities. Her work aims to develop methods that support both environmental performance and long-term building durability.
people.focus: Carbon-resilience nexus · Material LCA · Vulnerable communities · Hazard-prone regions

alumni.name: Hassan Anifowose
alumni.brief: VR and gamified learning environments; developed the Virtual Construction Lab for immersive construction assembly training. Now pursuing research at [institution placeholder].

alumni.name: Varusha Venkatraj
alumni.brief: Embodied-operational energy trade-offs; developed machine learning models to predict embodied and operational impacts of commercial buildings from simulated energy data.

alumni.name: Lena Baker M. Abu-Ennab
alumni.brief: LCA of 3D-printed cement-based materials; cradle-to-gate assessment of kaolin-enhanced calcium sulfoaluminate cement mixes, showing significant reductions in embodied energy and GWP.

alumni.name: Fatemeh Pariafsai
alumni.brief: Competency development in construction project management; proposed a conceptual competency model addressing gaps in management education and training programs.

alumni.name: Farnaz Nazari
alumni.brief: Optimization methods for building energy efficiency at early design stages; evaluated performance and limitations of commonly used algorithms in energy simulation workflows.

alumni.name: Omid Haghighi
alumni.brief: BIM-based multi-objective optimization of embodied energy, operational energy, and embodied water. Also contributed to I-O hybrid model development for estimating embodied water impacts.

alumni.name: Jason Bullen
alumni.brief: Embodied impacts of construction site logistics: material handling, equipment movement, and site planning. Used Delphi method for expert input. Best Research/Thesis Award.

alumni.name: Farshid Moosavi Tabatabaei
alumni.brief: BIM-based tool linking Autodesk Revit with an input-output hybrid database for embodied impact calculations. Also worked on visualization methods for maintenance-priority identification.

alumni.name: Shashank Singh
alumni.brief: Input-output hybrid models for embodied energy and carbon of construction materials. Examined facility manager preferences for flooring materials in hospital buildings.

alumni.group: SPACE Lab (Spatial Processing in Altered and Challenging Environments)
alumni.name: Hannah Park
alumni.brief: Spatial navigation, spatial representation, and cognitive styles. Established SPACE Lab research protocols. Work addressed navigation challenges during disasters where spatial cues are limited.

alumni.group: SPACE Lab (Spatial Processing in Altered and Challenging Environments)
alumni.name: Vahideh Karimimansoob
alumni.brief: Spatial ability and perception in challenging environments, with a focus on differences between heavy equipment operators and construction workers, and implications for safety and performance.
